Plot credible intervals of transition probabilities

Source: R/certainty_lsa.R
plot.lsa_certainty.Rd

plot() draws the result of certainty_lsa() as a circular forest plot: one spoke per transition, showing the observed transition probability and its credible interval, so the precisely and imprecisely estimated transitions can be seen side by side. The plot is drawn by plot_forest() with metric = "prob"; see that page for the layout and the arguments that can be passed through ....

Usage

# S3 method for class 'lsa_certainty'
plot(x, metric = "prob", ...)

Arguments

x

An lsa_certainty object from certainty_lsa().

metric

Interval to draw. Default "prob", the only interval a certainty result has.

...

Passed to plot_forest().

Value

A ggplot object, drawn when printed.

See also

certainty_lsa(), plot_forest().

Examples

cert <- certainty_lsa(lsa(group_regulation))
plot(cert)
